meaning_en: To express regret for a specific thing.
example_en: I apologise for the noise.
examples_extra: He apologised for his rude behaviour at dinner.
The company had to apologise for the mistake in the bill.
note_fa: sth یعنی something؛ الگوی رسمی‌تر عذرخواهی.

meaning_en: A statement saying you are sorry.
example_en: He made an apology for his behavior.
examples_extra: He wrote a letter of apology to his teacher.
She accepted his apology and they became friends again.
note_fa: در کتاب: I beg your pardon عذرخواهی رسمی‌تر است.

meaning_en: Arrive or happen later than planned.
example_en: My flight was delayed by two hours.
examples_extra: Her train was delayed, so she missed the meeting.
Our flight was delayed by three hours because of fog.
note_fa: دیر رسیدن — با by می‌آید: delayed by two hours.

meaning_en: Be delayed or stopped.
example_en: I was held up in traffic this morning.
examples_extra: We were held up in traffic for over an hour.
The train was held up because of heavy snow.

meaning_en: An informal way to say thank you.
example_en: "Cheers for helping me!"
examples_extra: 'Cheers for lending me your pen.'
Cheers! I really appreciate it.

meaning_en: (n) A time when something is late; (v) to make something late.
example_en: The flight had a two-hour delay.
examples_extra: Our flight was cancelled after a three-hour delay.
Bad weather delayed the start of the match.
note_fa: با to می‌آید: delay the meeting؛ بدون تاخیر: without delay.

meaning_en: Don't be anxious or afraid.
example_en: Don't worry, everything will be okay.
examples_extra: Don’t worry, I will help you with your homework.
Don’t worry about the test; you studied well.
note_fa: پاسخ رایج به عذرخواهی است: Sorry I’m late. – Don’t worry.

meaning_en: Used to apologize for a small mistake.
example_en: Excuse me, I didn't see you there.
examples_extra: Excuse me, I didn't see you standing there.
Oh, excuse me, I stepped on your foot.

meaning_en: A reason you give to explain a mistake.
example_en: What's your excuse for being late?
examples_extra: He made up an excuse for being late.
That's no excuse for such rude behaviour.
note_fa: بهانه؛ make an excuse یعنی بهانه آوردن.

meaning_en: A delay.
example_en: Sorry for the hold-up, traffic was bad.
examples_extra: There was a hold-up on the motorway this morning.
Sorry I'm late, there was a hold-up in traffic.

meaning_en: A polite way to say sorry or ask to repeat something.
example_en: I beg your pardon, could you say that again?
examples_extra: I beg your pardon, I didn't hear you.
I beg your pardon for stepping on your foot.
note_fa: رسمی است؛ برای عذرخواهی یا درخواست تکرار.

meaning_en: A formal way to say sorry for something.
example_en: I must apologise for the delay.
examples_extra: I must apologise for being late.
I must apologise for the mistake.

meaning_en: Stop someone talking or doing something.
example_en: Sorry to interrupt, but I have a question.
examples_extra: Please don't interrupt me while I'm speaking.
The phone call interrupted our dinner.
note_fa: قطع کردن حرف کسی؛ interrupt sb.

meaning_en: An apology for something you did.
example_en: I'm sorry for being late.
examples_extra: I’m sorry I'm late again.
I’m sorry about the mistake.

meaning_en: An apology for arriving after the expected time.
example_en: I'm sorry I'm late, the traffic was bad.
examples_extra: I’m sorry I’m late; the bus was delayed.
I’m sorry I’m late for the meeting.

meaning_en: Don't worry about it; it's not important.
example_en: "Sorry I'm late." "Never mind."
examples_extra: Never mind; we can try again tomorrow.
Oh, never mind; it really doesn't matter.

meaning_en: Used to say "you're welcome" or "it's easy".
example_en: "Thanks for your help!" "No problem!"
examples_extra: 'Can you help me?' 'No problem!'
She said it was no problem to drive us home.
note_fa: مشکلی نیست؛ هم برای تشکر هم موافقت.

meaning_en: Used to say "you're welcome" or "no problem".
example_en: "Thank you!" "Not at all."
examples_extra: 'Thank you so much!' 'Not at all!'
I'm not at all tired; let's keep walking.
note_fa: خواهش می‌کنم / اصلاً نه؛ دو کاربرد دارد.

meaning_en: To sleep longer than intended.
example_en: I overslept and missed my bus.
examples_extra: I oversleep whenever the alarm fails.
She tends to oversleep on Sundays.

meaning_en: An polite apology for interrupting someone.
example_en: Sorry to disturb you, but can I ask a question?
examples_extra: Sorry to disturb you, but the phone is for you.
I'm sorry to disturb you during your lunch.
note_fa: ببخشید مزاحم شدم؛ وقتی کسی مشغول است.

meaning_en: An apology for making someone wait.
example_en: Sorry to keep you waiting, the traffic was bad.
examples_extra: Sorry to keep you waiting; I won't be long.
I'm sorry to keep you waiting in the rain.
note_fa: ببخشید منتظر گذاشتم؛ I won't be long.

meaning_en: Very sorry for something you did.
example_en: I'm terribly sorry for being late.
examples_extra: Oh, I am terribly sorry.
She said she was terribly sorry.

meaning_en: A stronger way to say thank you.
example_en: Thanks very much for your help.
examples_extra: Oh, thanks very much indeed.
Thanks very much for everything.

meaning_en: Used to accept an apology or say no problem.
example_en: "Sorry I'm late." "That's all right."
examples_extra: That’s all right, don’t worry.
That’s quite okay with me.

meaning_en: Expressing thanks for someone's kindness.
example_en: "Can I help you?" "That's very kind of you."
examples_extra: That’s very kind of you.
Oh, that’s very kind of you!

meaning_en: It will happen or finish soon.
example_en: Don't worry, I won't be long.
examples_extra: It won't be long now.
Dinner won't be long, I promise.

meaning_en: An agreement or treaty.
example_en: The two nations reached a peace accord.
examples_extra: The two countries signed an accord.
They reached an accord after talks.

meaning_en: A judgment that a person is not guilty.
example_en: The jury's acquittal surprised many.
examples_extra: The trial ended in acquittal.
His sudden acquittal surprised everyone.

meaning_en: Evidence that one was elsewhere when a crime occurred.
example_en: He had a solid alibi for the night of the robbery.
examples_extra: He has a solid alibi.
Her alibi checked out fine.
note_fa: دلیل عدم حضور در صحنه جرم.

meaning_en: A formal agreement to stop fighting in a war.
example_en: The two nations signed an armistice to end the conflict.
examples_extra: The two sides signed an armistice.
The armistice ended the fighting.

meaning_en: Very strong and certain; impossible to doubt.
example_en: He gave a cast-iron guarantee that the work would be finished.
examples_extra: She has a cast-iron excuse.
The signed contract is completely cast-iron.
note_fa: کتاب: cast-iron excuse؛ محکم و غیرقابل تردید.

meaning_en: A reason given to justify a fault or offense.
example_en: He had no valid excuse for being late.
examples_extra: Being tired is no excuse for rudeness.
He made an excuse and left early.

meaning_en: To officially declare someone free from blame.
example_en: New evidence helped exonerate the innocent man.
examples_extra: The court exonerated the accused man.
New evidence exonerated her completely.
note_fa: تبرئه کردن؛ رسماً بی‌گناه اعلام کردن.

meaning_en: Easily damaged or broken; not strong or solid.
example_en: The excuse he gave was rather flimsy.
examples_extra: The flimsy bridge swayed dangerously.
She wore a flimsy dress.

meaning_en: To stop being angry and forget past offenses.
example_en: It's time to forgive and forget their past mistakes.
examples_extra: It's time to forgive and forget.
Let's forgive and forget the past.

meaning_en: Deeply felt and sincere.
example_en: She offered a heartfelt apology for her mistake.
examples_extra: She gave a heartfelt apology.
His warm thanks were truly heartfelt.

meaning_en: (informal) Unconvincing or weak; unsatisfactory.
example_en: That's a pretty lame excuse for being late.
examples_extra: The horse went lame after the race.
He gave a lame excuse for being late.

meaning_en: To forgive someone for a mistake or crime.
example_en: I beg your pardon, I didn't mean to interrupt.
examples_extra: The president pardoned the prisoner.
Pardon me, what did you say?

meaning_en: A formal agreement between countries to end a war.
example_en: The two nations signed a peace treaty after years of conflict.
examples_extra: They signed a peace treaty.
The peace treaty ended the war.

meaning_en: Not real or genuine; fake.
example_en: His apology sounded completely phoney and insincere.
examples_extra: His posh accent was completely phoney.
He gave a phoney name.

meaning_en: Occurring, awarded, or appearing after death.
example_en: He received a posthumous award for his bravery.
examples_extra: He received a posthumous award for bravery.
The posthumous novel was published last year.
note_fa: پس از مرگ؛ اعطاشده یا رخ‌داده پس از مرگ.

meaning_en: A false reason given to hide the real one.
example_en: He used illness as a pretext for not attending.
examples_extra: He left on the pretext of feeling ill.
The war began under a false pretext.

meaning_en: Deep regret or guilt for a wrong committed.
example_en: The criminal showed no remorse for his actions.
examples_extra: He felt deep sincere remorse.
She showed no remorse at all.

meaning_en: feel deep regret for past actions
example_en: He truly repented his past mistakes and sought forgiveness.
examples_extra: He repented his past crimes.
She repented deeply and sincerely.

meaning_en: feeling deep regret for one's past actions
example_en: His sincere repentance was evident in his changed behavior.
examples_extra: He showed true sincere repentance.
Her repentance seemed quite sincere.
note_fa: کتاب: noun = repentance؛ توبه و پشیمانی.

meaning_en: a temporary delay of punishment or relief from trouble
example_en: The prisoner received a last-minute reprieve from execution.
examples_extra: The rain gave us a reprieve.
He won a last-minute legal reprieve.

meaning_en: A formal agreement between two or more countries.
example_en: The two nations signed a peace treaty.
examples_extra: They signed a peace treaty.
The treaty ended the war.
